name: erecle
description: Cleans Amazon Kindle URLs by removing excess parameters for a cleaner, more readable and bookmarkable format.
host_permissions_reason: The extension accesses amazon.com and regional amazon sites to identify and clean Kindle book URLs by removing tracking and session parameters, making the URLs cleaner and more bookmarkable.
reason_for_remote_code: This extension does not use remote code execution. All functionality is contained within local scripts.
